name: figurinhas
description: Marketplace de figurinhas da Copa - monorepo com NestJS, React, Prisma e PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:init: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.check: npm run prisma:validate && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/api/node_modules apps/web/node_modules apps/api/dist apps/web/dist
